policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="requestBody" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />

        
        
            
                <set-variable name="confidenceThreshold" value="@{
                    var body = (JObject)context.Variables["requestBody"];
                    return body?["confidence_threshold"]?.Value() ?? 0.7;
                }" />

                
                
                    <when condition="@((double)context.Variables["confidenceThreshold"] < 0.5)">
                        
                            
                            @{
                                return new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("error", "confidence_threshold_too_low"),
                                    new JProperty("message", "Clinical reasoning requires a minimum confidence threshold of 0.5 for patient safety"),
                                    new JProperty("requested", (double)context.Variables["confidenceThreshold"]),
                                    new JProperty("minimum", 0.5)
                                ).ToString();
                            }
                        
                    
                
            
        

        
        <set-variable name="clinicalContext" value="@{
            var body = (JObject)context.Variables["requestBody"];
            var scenario = body?["scenario"] as JObject ?? new JObject();
            var inferenceMode = body?["inference_mode"]?.ToString() ?? "forward_chaining";
            var reasoningType = body?["reasoning_type"]?.ToString() ?? "diagnosis_support";

            var ctx = new JObject();
            ctx["inference_mode"] = inferenceMode;
            ctx["reasoning_type"] = reasoningType;
            ctx["evidence_required"] = body?["evidence_required"]?.Value() ?? true;
            ctx["clinical_validation"] = body?["clinical_validation"]?.Value() ?? true;

            // Determine risk level based on reasoning type
            var riskLevel = "standard";
            switch (reasoningType.ToLower()) {
                case "differential_diagnosis":
                case "treatment_optimization":
                    riskLevel = "high";
                    break;
                case "uncertainty_analysis":
                case "decision_tree_generation":
                    riskLevel = "medium";
                    break;
            }
            ctx["risk_level"] = riskLevel;

            return ctx;
        }" />

        
        
            @((string)context.Variables["plnOperation"])
        
        
            @(((JObject)context.Variables["clinicalContext"]).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))
        
        
            true

choose.when:
<set-variable name="responseBody" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />

                @{
                    var response = (JObject)context.Variables["responseBody"];
                    var clinicalCtx = (JObject)context.Variables["clinicalContext"];

                    // Add PLN metadata to response
                    response["pln_metadata"] = new JObject(
                        new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                        new JProperty("reasoning_engine", "PLN-4.0"),
                        new JProperty("inference_mode", clinicalCtx["inference_mode"]),
                        new JProperty("reasoning_type", clinicalCtx["reasoning_type"]),
                        new JProperty("risk_level", clinicalCtx["risk_level"]),
                        new JProperty("medical_disclaimer", "For clinical professional use only. All recommendations require qualified medical review.")
                    );

                    return response.ToString();
                }
